title: Microscope Slide — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Scan and focus
scenes.purpose: Scan across the slide at x400 and pull focus from shallow debris to the idea network as it connects.
visuals: Fixed dark-field eyepiece with reticle and 50 µm scale bar
Specimen pans and decelerates onto the hub
Focus gauge moves plane 1 to plane 2; debris blurs, network sharpens
Strands grow from the central idea cell to five nodes

beats.development: Slide scans right-to-centre at focus plane 1; kicker and title fade in.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Focus pulls to plane 2; the network resolves and strands connect the idea to its nodes.

scenes.title: Magnify one junction
scenes.purpose: Lock onto a registered junction and show it at x2000 with its own scale bar, then hold the sharp plane.
visuals: Amber reticle box snaps onto the junction
Dashed leaders draw to the inset
Inset opens with the same sample coordinates at 5x; 5 µm scale bar appears after the inset completes

beats.development: Reticle locks, leaders draw, x2000 inset opens, then its scale bar and meta line appear.
Hold the sharp focus plane; full composition settled for reading.

findings: Scan decelerates onto the feature before the focus change; magnification follows only after the structure is sharp.
justifiedHolds: 2.35–3.0 s hold of the settled focus plane, as the style requires.

notes: Canvas 2D renders every frame from one paused GSAP timeline (window.__timelines.video); hf-seek redraws.
No preview recipes were listed in STYLE.json; the core characteristic action is demonstrated.
